title: Generic scalar models on prescribed w-contractible covers of irreducible affines
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and put $R=\Gamma(*,\Lambda)$. For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], let $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and write $D(T,\Lambda)=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda_T)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Dualizable means admitting evaluation and coevaluation for derived tensor with unit $\Lambda_T[0]$, satisfying both triangle identities. Put $L_T(P)=\Lambda_T\otimes^L_{\underline R}\underline P$ for the canonical scalar realization [def-zl-condensed-scalar-realization], where underlines are discrete constant sheaves. A perfect ring complex is isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex].

Let $X$ be nonempty irreducible affine, and let $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric generic point, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-irreducible-components]. Let $K\in D(X,\Lambda)$ be dualizable. There exist a perfect $P\in D(R)$ and an isomorphism $\alpha:K|_\eta\simeq L_\eta(P)$. For every such $P,\alpha$ and every affine faithfully flat ind-etale morphism $u:U\to X$ with $U$ w-contractible [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra, sk-def-pe-wlocal], there exists a derived isomorphism $K|_U\simeq L_U(P)$ with this same $P$.

More precisely, put $S=\pi_0U$, $S_\eta=\pi_0(U\times_X\eta)$ with the profinite quotient topologies [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. On a profinite slice use the analogous module-sheaf derived category and scalar realization with coefficients restricted from $\Lambda$. Let $\pi_U^*$ be the component inverse-image equivalence on dualizable objects [lem-zl-condensed-wcontractible-lisse-evaluation]. There exists a dualizable $M\in D(S,\Lambda)$ with $\pi_U^*M\simeq K|_U$. For $r:S_\eta\to S$, the induced generic-fiber isomorphism gives $r^*M\simeq L_{S_\eta}(P)$. There exists a continuous section $s:S\to S_\eta$ of $r$, and inverse image along any such section identifies $M\simeq L_S(P)$. All these are isomorphisms of derived objects with the canonical pulled-back coefficient rings. No assumption of reducedness or coefficient flatness is made.

proof.text: Pull K to the geometric point, preserving dualizability, and apply the geometric-field perfect model step.

Take the simultaneous component square system. Lift K restricted to U through its normalized corner using contractible_corner_lisse_lift. Construct the ordinary corner scalar comparison from beta and coefficient_eq by module linearity, with no additional existence assumption. For the scheme comparison, lift upperStarFromPointComp using the proved condensedPointModule_comparison_linear and precompose with extendScalarsIsoComapInv. Its underlying map is definitionally the required schemeUnderlying composite.

Compose the square, beta, genericRestriction, the fixed alpha and the scalar comparisons. Full faithfulness of the normalized generic-fibre corner gives its unique preimage delta; the isoEquiv inverse identity proves generic_induced.

Faithful flatness gives going-down. Each component of U has a generalization over the generic point; the fibre-product point theorem lifts it to the geometric fibre. Thus its component map is surjective. W-contractibility makes pi_0 U extremally disconnected, so projectivity supplies a continuous section. For each section take its normalized SectionComparison, define gamma as the inverse identity comparison followed by the pullback of delta and the scalar comparison, and cancel the identity isomorphism to prove the sections equation. Apply the U corner to gamma and compose with beta inverse and scalarU to obtain model.
